canon.style: Cinematic semi-realistic digital painting, mature Mediterranean romantic drama.
canon.identity: Portrait and landscape variants must preserve the approved age, face, hair, wardrobe, props, actions and emotional beat for the same scene.
canon.composition: Landscape is an independently staged 16:9 composition with usable horizontal space, not a crop, stretch, blurred-background fill or UI overlay. Keep faces, hands, significant props and architecture clear above the dialogue-safe lower area.
canon.continuity: Use the supplied portrait source as an identity and canon anchor while changing framing for desktop. Preserve location, time of day, spatial logic and route-specific props.

viewportAcceptance.selection: Select source by measured viewport aspect ratio; do not bind scene or save state to a variant. Resize must switch source without blanking the last valid frame.

acceptance: All ten families require a mechanically verified landscape output and independent Web High review in both portrait and landscape before PASS_STAGE8_EP1_PRODUCTION_ART_ACCEPTANCE.
